Name: Simple Tool Belt 2 (New Update)
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]✦ Simple Tool Belt ✦[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Keep your tools in [b]one backpack slot[/b], with a [b]ten-position quick tray[/b] and optional Smart Switching.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🧰 Features[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]• Store one of each category: [b]Axe, Pickaxe, Hoe, Watering Can, Scythe, Milk Pail, Shears, Weapon and Fishing Rod[/b]. The Weapon category accepts a melee weapon or slingshot; pans and ordinary items are excluded.
• Keep your original upgrades, enchantments, water, bait, tackle and tool data.
• Rearrange your belt positions; a small badge shows the selected tool, and returning to the belt remembers your selection.
• Backpack Organize puts the belt in hotbar slot 1.
• Lost-belt recovery: after two day-end checks confirm it is missing, read Clint’s recovery letter and collect a free replacement connected to your stored tools.
• Mouse, keyboard and controller controls, with menus and settings in all [b]12 game languages[/b].[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]📬 Get the Belt[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Have Clint upgrade a tool or process a geode, then read his letter the following morning. Buy the belt at his normal shop for [b]10,000g[/b]; all ten positions are included. Previous geode processing or an upgraded Clint tool also qualifies on existing saves.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🎮 Using Your Belt[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Manage:[/b] right-click the belt in your backpack. Click a backpack tool to store it, click two belt positions to swap them, or right-click a stored tool to withdraw it.
[b]Choose:[/b] select the belt in your hotbar and press Action when nothing is interactable to open the [b]2 × 5 tray[/b]. Click a tool or use your first ten hotbar bindings, normally 1–9 and 0. Use it with your normal Use Tool control.
[b]Controller:[/b] navigate with the D-pad/left stick; A selects and B closes. In management, A stores/reorders, X withdraws, and shoulder buttons change backpack pages.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]⚙ Smart Switching & Settings[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Smart Switching starts Off.[/b] Enable it in the belt menu to choose a stored tool for rocks, trees, diggable ground, dry crops, scythe targets, ready farm animals or monsters when you perform a tool action. Your previous item returns after the complete action, including charged watering.
Smart settings let you choose the automatic tool categories and optionally allow switching while holding other items; that option starts Off. Fishing rods and utility tools stay manual.
Turn off [b]Open quick tray with Action[/b] in Smart settings if you prefer a separate tray button. Optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] lets you assign tray-opening and Smart Switching bindings; both start unassigned.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🎣 Fishing & Utility Tools[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]’s [b]Hand Mirror[/b] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]’ [b]Paint Bucket[/b] can share the same ten positions when their mods are installed. Choose your loadout if all eleven categories are available.
To change bait or tackle, withdraw your rod first. [b]Simple Fishing Bag 1.2+[/b], if installed, can access rods in your carried belt and refill attachments after fishing.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]🛠 Requirements & Important Notes[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.2+[/url]. Extract SimpleToolBelt into Mods, replacing the previous version. Generic Mod Config Menu, Fashion Sense and Alternative Textures are optional.
Withdraw tools before using Clint’s upgrade service or the forge, and before uninstalling. Compatible subclasses of the supported tools can be stored; unusual custom targets may need manual selection. All multiplayer players should use the same version.[/color][/size][/center]
